sections.title: Introduction
paragraphs: I am a software engineer focused on building reliable and maintainable applications across frontend, backend, and cloud environments.
I enjoy turning complex ideas into practical software solutions that solve real-world problems and deliver long-term value.

sections.title: Background
paragraphs: Before becoming a software engineer, I studied chemistry and computational research, where I explored scientific computing, numerical methods, and mathematical approaches to solving complex problems.
This background has shaped my analytical thinking and continues to influence how I approach software engineering, from understanding complex problems to designing structured and reliable solutions.

sections.title: Current Role
paragraphs: I currently work as a Software Development Engineer (RDSS) at eZoom Information, contributing to production system integration and full-stack application development.

My works spans infrastructure maintenance, deployment automation, backend development, frontend integration, and system design, allowing me to contribute throughout the entire software delivery lifecycle.

sections.title: Engineering Approach
paragraphs: I believe good software begins with clear architecture, well-defined responsibilities, and thoughtful system design.

When solving problems, I look beyond the immediate implementation and consider ownership, data flow, deployment, documentation, and long-term maintainability. My goal is to build systems that remain understandable, reliable, and easier to evolve over time.

sections.title: Technical Focus
paragraphs: My work primarily focuses on full-stack web applications, backend services, relational databases, cloud deployment, and development automation. I enjoy building complete systems that connect these technologies into reliable production solutions.
